Six numbers, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25 and 26 are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown here. Find the number on the face opposite 26.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f98dc76ed0a29766c4b8d166e2295b479754a8f5b0c66a0986fdd67e71d4292.png]
questions.solution:
For find the opposite surface of '26', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c75b6aef9a7644f4c99d9daf4749517d98f8f6c53a943529b14e11f89cca3e4.png] 

From both dices, 5 is common. So, we can rotate in clockwise direction start from 26.

24 → 21

23 → 25

26 → 22

So, 22 will be opposite to 26.

Hence, the correct answer is "22".

questions.question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

False : Untrue
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: 

False : Untrue → These both words are synonyms. 

Similarly, 

**Trip : Journey **→ These both words are synonyms. Both "Trip" and "Journey" mean traveling from one place to another. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Trip : Journey**".

questions.question: Anu, Geeta, Mittal, Radha, Hema and Kriti were sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. They were sitting at an equal distance from one another. Hema and Radha were sitting exactly next to each other. Anu was to the immediate right of Kriti. Geeta was to the immediate left of Hema. Mittal is to the immediate right of Radha. Who among the following is sitting to the immediate left of Geeta?
questions.solution:
**Given: **Anu, Geeta, Mittal, Radha, Hema and Kriti were sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. They were sitting at an equal distance from one another. 

1) Geeta was to the immediate left of Hema. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cc913e8c79765517ae094e904df1e14569f3ad97c1bfc6685ff7a8735e16ada.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c9b427e6306ec2a7065e8378b76663bb934f75fe6e0c23226a7d3a9d12d0f2d.png] 

2) Hema and Radha were sitting exactly next to each other. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/606b996ca33429bb60ecf6baea8dd95f153d72a6444d8bec94f5ef962457f5f6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a477dc1f30f76379e37e3156e7f5697b5b70a7da2f917bcfbf9743728cca444.png] 

3) Mittal is to the immediate right of Radha. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4c963bd87a723f8b82f4fd4046ad6e1ade83db5835d1a4780f0ea7ec090f308.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd52489ea58a12ac029fd442b85d0858234b4d01bab1aad1aa6ec142beac90f4.png] 

4) Anu was to the immediate right of Kriti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ac9104a120110b424c731e85e5e376fe8fe1bfe48512d601aafc9a37eb2ff30.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2edbfd0bf895a3bb5afa1c4b7c7d3b9aa88c64fa0f8d13666593f6a7907ad3c0.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Anu is sitting to the immediate left of Geeta.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

18 * 90 * 3 * 27 * 8 = 0

Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the sixth term is related to the fifth term.

20 : 205 :: 75 : ? :: 105 : 1055
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: 1st number × 10 + 5 = 2nd number

20 : 205 → 20 × 10 + 5 = 205

105 : 1055 → 105 × 10 + 5 = 1055

Similarly, 75 : ? → 75 × 10 + 5 = **755**

Hence, the correct answer is "**755**".

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some camels are donkeys.

Some donkeys are cows.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cows are camels.

II. Some donkeys are camels.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
Statements:

Some camels are donkeys.

Some donkeys are cows.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0393b00c1e3b44f1e9e19f5b9eba7cb9a8ec3e5f4d0c109e9523e1ac6b23257.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some cows are camels. - **False **(because there is no direct relation between cows and camels. So, it can be possible but not definite)

II. Some donkeys are camels. - **True **(because Some camels are donkeys. So, Some donkeys are camels too)

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusions II follow".

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52d6ab283b75fa0add5bbe3dabb593fa2969d44f05eb749c030966e0834056c3.png]

questions.question:
Six letters A, B, C, P, Q and R are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the letter on the face opposite to A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88faf9176f84046e8b9ebb920a481e43dd7049e75ac8b3a2c2aec1bcc1e25a50.png]
questions.solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'A', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/344ac6a9f44cd658f59ee6d5430978cefcdfc05246e119bf88a73ce644ee60d1.png] 

From both dices, Q is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

P is opposite to Q.

R is opposite to C.

So, B will be opposite to A.

Hence, the correct answer is "B".
